**[CPU에서 선택지를 판단하는 소형 개방형 모델 Julia 1](https://marktechpost.com/2026/09/26/supersonic-labs-releases-julia-1-a-144-3m-parameter-open-decision-model-that-runs-on-a-cpu)**
